$comment: Per-product WebP output quality rules. Used by scripts/reencode-product-webp.py to re-encode product images to /assets/products/<slug>-{800,1600}.webp at controlled quality — avoids over-compression while keeping bytes reasonable. Adjust `quality800` / `quality1600` (0–100) or `method` (0=fast … 6=slowest/best) per product. `source` is the pointer file (relative to repo root) whose original binary will be pulled from CDN as the re-encoding source; pick the highest-resolution / cleanest available.

beaid.notes: Clean product render on white — high quality, gradients matter.

comwell.notes: Photographic — slightly lower quality is fine, JPG source already lossy.

ted.notes: No PNG source available — best we can do is re-encode from existing 1600 WebP. Upload a higher-resolution PNG to improve further.

visiony.notes: Source is 1000×1000. Re-encode from existing WebP for now; upload a larger PNG to reach true 1600px.

scd.notes: PNG source is only 700px. Upscaled Lanczos to 1600 for the -1600 variant; consider re-shooting/regenerating for sharper output.
